notes:
A far better narrator — try it.

Settings › Voice now has a BEST / LIGHTER switch. BEST is a new engine (Supertonic) that reads at 44.1 kHz instead of 16 kHz — much closer to a real recording — and carries ten narrators in a single download, so once it's there you can change voice instantly with nothing to wait for.

It's off by default on purpose: it's a big change to the part of the app that matters most, so you turn it on rather than having it turned on for you. The lighter voice stays exactly as it was, and you can switch back at any time.

Also fixed: a voice change could land mid-sentence, and a failed voice download could drop narration to the robotic system voice even when a good voice was already on your phone.
